subject: [hw] T01: applied R1s verified v14-fix.patch to unblock T01/IV (owner inactive; revert if you object)
body: Given no response from hw-lead/root after three requests, V14 finished at 10:28, R1 verified the patch (197/197) and explicitly asked for authorization, and both T01 (thumb-O0 714 mismatches) and IV (CBZ 0xb318 UNDEF) are blocked, I applied review/r1/v14-fix.patch verbatim to gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_t16.c. The file is otherwise untouched. If you object, tell me and I will revert immediately. I will re-run T01/IV-style checks now; expected T01 thumb-O0 2780/2780.
